decisions: Known operations are resolved through Roslyn symbols and exact operation identities, not text-only method names.
Unsupported or unresolved invocations remain Unknown; there is no fallback to O(n).
Known operation mappings carry complexity, execution semantics, provenance, complexity-case metadata, and diagnostic metadata.
KnownOperationRegistry.Bcl remains BCL-only; KnownOperationRegistry.Default combines BCL and LINQ mappings for extraction.
Deferred LINQ pipeline creation is O(1); enumeration cost is counted only when a supported terminal operation or foreach consumes the pipeline.
OrderBy, OrderByDescending, ThenBy, and ThenByDescending remain deferred at creation and count sorting only when consumed.
BIG0001 and BIG9000 are Info diagnostics disabled by default; BIG1001, BIG1002, and BIG1003 are Info diagnostics enabled by default.
BIG1003 reports deferred ordering only when supported consumption is proven inside an analyzable loop.
constraints: Do not modify inherited projects outside analyzer/.
Do not create ProjectReference, binary reference, local package dependency, or transitive dependency on inherited projects.
Do not add Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Workspaces, MathNet, or SymPy to the isolated analyzer.
Do not implement call graph, interprocedural analysis, recursion, recurrence solving, CodeFix, memory complexity, parallel complexity, or probabilistic complexity in Phase 4.
Keep analyzer hot paths deterministic, cancellation-aware, and free from I/O, network access, process execution, and reflection-heavy behavior.
validations: Analyzer restore, Release build, Release test, and Release pack pass.
Tests cover semantic BCL/LINQ resolution, custom homonymous non-matches, Unknown preservation, deferred and immediate LINQ semantics, actionable diagnostics, and BIG9000 behavior.
Package inspection confirms the analyzer DLL under analyzers/dotnet/cs/, README.md, no lib assembly, no dependency groups, no inherited assemblies, no Workspaces, and no MathNet.
SupportedDiagnostics, DiagnosticDescriptors, AnalyzerReleases.Unshipped.md, and EN/pt-BR analyzer docs expose the same public diagnostics.

Inherited solution restore/build were checked without editing upstream; a cache issue and documentation-file lock required isolated package cache and redirected documentation output for a clean build.
knownPendingItems: Project-local calls remain Unknown until interprocedural analysis.
Call graph, recursion detection, and recurrence solving remain unsupported.
The known-operation registry intentionally covers a documented subset rather than full BCL/LINQ parity.
